changelog: Instant Video Playback Start: decreased initial playback buffer to 500ms for near-instant video start
Gradual Background Buffer: ExoPlayer streams up to 30s-100s in the background for stall-free viewing
Rapid Rebuffer Recovery: shortened post-rebuffer pause threshold to 2,000ms
Filter in-player audio languages by stream availability
Volume overlay, pause auto-hide, video counter, and grouped quality settings
Block channel directly from player playback controls
Follow YouTube suggestions from feed rows
Silent background update checks and signed CI release pipeline
